data.label: include
data.reason_zh: SSPE把语言技能修订当作待验更新，用观察到的增益与回退构造兼容修订，使同一共享技能跨任务持续演化，属方法类持续自改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: uses the observed gains and regressions to construct a compatible revision rather than merely rejecting the update
scope_support.object_quote: SSPE treats an unconstrained skill revision as a proposed update, identifies acquired capabilities with which it may interfere
scope_support.persistence_quote: This enables one shared skill to evolve across latent and recurring task contexts
